pixel_oracle.applies_to: dark theme declared sidebar capture only
pixel_oracle.rule: at least 8x3 adjacent samples on a 4px-at-96-DPI grid, RGB each >=190 and max-min <=16
pixel_oracle.interpretation: large neutral light-patch candidate; retain original RGB frame for visual review
pixel_oracle.limitations: Does not detect every color artifact, text clipping, stale icons, or anomalies between samples. Light theme requires visual review.
